build_vae_model: build a variational autoencoder model using distrax distributions and haiku for binarized MNIST
create_encoder_decoder: create an encoder and decoder network using haiku linear layers for latent space modeling
run_vae_training: run VAE training on binarized MNIST with Adam optimizer and ELBO loss computation
create_elbo_loss: create a loss function that computes negative ELBO with log likelihood and KL divergence terms
sample_vae_images: sample reconstructed images from the VAE likelihood distribution using distrax Bernoulli
